thread:
alex: Heads up — got ACME's onboarding ramp checklist via sales. They want RBAC matrix, KMS integration details, audit log retention, and our incident playbook. Dropped the doc link: https://drive.redwood/acme/ramp-reqs
maria: Can you paste the exact Qs they sent? easier to map answers.
alex: Top asks:
  - Who can access tenant keys? (Q5)
  - Do you support customer-provided KMS / BYOK? (Q12)
  - Audit log retention and export options (Q18)
  - Proof of remediation for recent vuln they flagged (Q22)
  - Incident response contact + evidence bundle availability (Q30)
sam: FYI cc @acme-eng — they expect an initial response by EOW.
maria: For Q5 I'd recommend we list the minimal role set and patterns: PlatformAdmin (full infra), OpsSRE (deploy + incident ops), SupportReadOnly (ticketing only). Mention service accounts and short-lived tokens via our provisioning flow.
jordan: For BYOK: we support customer-wrapped DEKs (envelope encryption). Customer can bring KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP CMEK) — we store only the wrapped DEK and never import raw KEKs. Need runbook for key handshake + proof of possession.
alex: I'll sketch the keyflow diagram. Also they flagged CVE-2024-4321 in lib-http-client — patched in 1.2.3. We need to be explicit about mitigation and timeline.
maria: Vuln triage note: patch applied to staging 2025-02-12 (build 562). Prod rolling deploy scheduled Tue 02:00–04:00 PST next week. Mitigations in place: WAF rule + increased request throttling; monitoring alert firing on unusual 5xx patterns.
sec-bot: Reminder: Incident playbook should include customer-facing timeline, evidence bundle (redacted logs), and forensic snapshot procedures.
sam: ACME also asked whether key rotation can be done without downtime.
jordan: Yes — we support hot-rotate with double-write for active DEKs. Flow (ops snippet):
```
1. Generate new DEK
2. Encrypt DEK with customer-KMS -> new_wrapped
3. Start double-write (old_wrapped && new_wrapped) for 300s
4. Switch readers to prefer new_wrapped
5. Retire old_wrapped after successful verification
```
Expected impact: <5s per connection for new bindings; no global downtime.
maria: For audit logs: default retention is 90 days. Enterprise add-on supports 365 days and S3 export (customer-owned bucket) for longer retention + SIEM ingest. Will include sample redacted log lines.
alex: Draft answers are in the doc: https://drive.redwood/acme/acme-ramp-draft.md — diagram placeholder in page 3.
sam: Anything we need from the QSA? they asked for pen-test report and KMS audit logs.
maria: We'll provide redacted pen-test summary and an appendix for KMS audit artifacts (key rotation events, access_grants). We should also include role mapping screenshots from IAM console.
jordan: I'll prepare script to pull a 7-day log slice and redact IPs. Will add the command and a note about hashing userids for customer-provided samples.
alex: Action items: alex -> diagram + submit draft answers; jordan -> redacted logs + rotation snippet; maria -> finalize Q answers + vuln timeline text; sam -> customer comms + negotiate EOW cadence.
sam: ack. I'll tell ACME we aim to send initial packet Friday EOD and v2 after their QSA review next Wed.
maria: Quick legal check: any wording around "customer key custody" needs legal sign-off. I'll loop in legal after I finish the text.
alex: tagging final: please review the draft by Thu AM so we can merge.
jordan: noted. I'll drop the log samples here once redacted.
sec-bot: Automated note: create evidence bundle folder -> /evidence/acme/2025-02-14 when ready. Remember to stamp with build hashes and deploy IDs.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks team.
